field.label: Debug Mode
field.comment:
Enable to write debug records (API requests, responses) into a debug log, and to store full request/response payloads in the usage log.
Errors and token usage are always logged.

field.label: Payload Retention (Days)
field.comment: Full request/response payloads older than this many days are removed from the usage log by a daily cron. 0 keeps them forever. Token usage statistics are never deleted.
